knobs.name: bmp_line_dropped

L2-1: every sample: |Temperature - bmpManager.Reading.temperature| <= 0.5 degC and |GyroX,Y,Z - imuManager.Reading.rotation| <= 1.0 deg/s against the Reading sample nearest in FSW time and within 1.5 s (else unpaired); at least 30 pairs each

knobs.mechanism: sysTester.BENCH_LINE(BMP280, OFF) is inserted directly after the START marker, so the precondition and the first samples of the window are untouched and the BMP280 is unpowered for the rest of the window; the procedure's BENCH_LINE(BMP280, ON) after the END marker and its settle wait restore it, so no later test is disturbed. The unpowered sensor fails the manager's reset write (DeviceFailure, BmpManager.cpp lines 57 to 63) and leaves no Reading sample to pair within 1.5 s

knobs.name: mpu_line_dropped

L2-2: |last Roll - first Roll| >= 20 deg or |last Pitch - first Pitch| >= 20 deg across the tilt action

|Roll - atan2(a_y, a_z)| <= 1.0 deg and |Pitch - atan2(-a_x, sqrt(a_y^2 + a_z^2))| <= 1.0 deg for every Roll and Pitch sample against the imuManager.Reading sample nearest in FSW time and within 1.5 s (else unpaired), samples within 3 s of the logged tilt action excluded; at least 25 pairs

knobs.mechanism: sysTester.BENCH_LINE(MPU6050, OFF) is inserted directly after the START marker, so the precondition is untouched and the MPU6050 is unpowered for the rest of the window, so roll and pitch freeze and the tilt is not seen; the procedure's BENCH_LINE(MPU6050, ON) after the END marker and its settle wait restore it

knobs.name: sensor_line_kept_on

L5-1: F: 3.5 s <= t(event sensorMonitor.Bmp280Lost) - t(sysTester.BENCH_LINE(line=BMP280, state=OFF) sent) <= 10 s (FSW clock, the one such command and event of the window)
L5-2: F: 1.5 s <= t(event sensorMonitor.Mpu6050Lost) - t(sysTester.BENCH_LINE(line=MPU6050, state=OFF) sent) <= 10 s (FSW clock, the one such command and event of the window)

knobs.mechanism: argument `state` of sysTester.BENCH_LINE is rewritten from OFF to ON: the sensor keeps answering, so it is never lost and never returns
